title: Your assessment-centre crib sheet
label: Sample · Amelia Chen, Economics, Bristol → Barclays

sections.title: Your 30-second introduction
sections.text: I’m Amelia, a penultimate-year BSc Economics student at the University of Bristol, predicted a 2:1. During my corporate finance internship at Redcliffe Partners, I screened 12 UK software companies and flagged 4 whose recurring-revenue models matched an acquisition brief, presenting my reasons to an associate.
prompts: Barclays combines UK corporate banking and an investment bank. Add why that mix matters to you and the IBD work you want to do.

stories.title: Analysis · Redcliffe Partners
stories.text: I researched 12 UK software companies, recorded business descriptions, revenue and EBITDA where publicly available, and compared them in Excel. I flagged 4 companies because their recurring-revenue models matched the acquisition-screen brief. I presented the table and my selection reasons to an associate.
stories.prompt: Add what happened after the handover only if you know.

stories.title: Responsibility and teamwork · Pho House
stories.text: I worked 12 hours a week alongside university and trained 3 new colleagues on ordering and till procedures. During one busy service, I spotted a duplicate payment, informed the shift lead and helped process the correction.
stories.prompt: Explain how you trained the colleagues or spotted the error; no financial saving is recorded.

stories.title: Technical analysis · LVMH valuation project
stories.text: I built a DCF and trading-comparables valuation in Excel using public annual-report data, compared LVMH with 3 luxury-sector peers and tested revenue growth of 3%, 5% and 7%. I presented sensitivity findings to a 4-person seminar team.
stories.prompt: Be ready to explain how growth and margin assumptions affected your valuation. This was a university project, not a live investment recommendation.

sections.title: What they’re really asking
sections.text: They want a recommendation you can defend with evidence. For Redcliffe, explain the recurring-revenue criterion, why the four companies met it, and what would make you change your view. Separate what you did from what the wider team did.

sections.title: Why Barclays · personalise this
sections.text: UK-headquartered, with UK corporate banking, a private bank and an investment bank under one roof. That you understand Barclays is UK-headquartered, serves UK companies as well as global ones, and that this matters to you.
prompts: Why does working with UK companies in an international bank appeal to you?
Connect that reason to the investment banking work you want to do.

sections.title: Questions to ask
items: How do interns contribute to an acquisition screen or company analysis in this team?
What makes an analyst’s recommendation useful to the people reviewing it?
What feedback helps interns improve fastest?

sections.title: Gaps to prepare
items: What happened after the associate received the screen? The CV does not confirm an outcome.
Which evidence would you use to defend the four selections?
Why Barclays IBD specifically? The CV does not record a personal firm reason.
Which assumptions drove your LVMH valuation most, and why?

source: Built from Amelia’s sample CV and The Desk’s Barclays research.
